title: Commercializing the Package Flow: Cross-Sampling Physical Products Through E-Commerce Warehouses

abstract: We examine how the information in public signals (e.g., earnings, analysts’ forecasts) affects firms’ voluntary disclosures. We consider levered firms and information structures such that investors update their beliefs about both the mean and variance of the firm’s cash flows. We predict that firms that, conditional on the public signal, have a higher default risk are less likely to disclose. For firms with low ex ante default risk, larger positive surprises following the public signal initially increase the disclosure likelihood because they indicate a higher mean of cash flows. However, too large positive surprises may reduce the disclosure likelihood of these firms, because the larger surprise is also indicative of higher variance and, thus, higher probability of default. Symmetrically, larger negative surprises may increase disclosure for firms with high ex ante default risk, despite the more pessimistic inference about the mean, because the higher variance makes it more likely that these firms avoid default. Extending our analysis to multiple analysts’ forecasts, we predict that not only consensus, but also dispersion affect firms’ disclosure likelihood. Consensus conveys information about the mean and variance of cash flows, whereas dispersion is informative about the precision of analysts’ signals, which in turn affects the information content of forecasts. This paper was accepted by Suraj Srinivasan, accounting. Funding: D. Lee-Lo gratefully acknowledges financial support from the Accounting Research Center at Kellogg.
abstract_zh: 我们考察公共信号（如盈余、分析师预测）中的信息如何影响企业的自愿披露。我们考虑杠杆企业以及这样的信息结构：投资者会同时更新其对企业现金流均值和方差的信念。我们预测，在给定公共信号的条件下，违约风险更高的企业更不可能进行披露。对于事前违约风险较低的企业，公共信号之后更大的正向意外最初会提高披露可能性，因为它们表明现金流的均值更高。然而，过大的正向意外可能会降低这些企业的披露可能性，因为更大的意外也表明方差更高，从而违约概率更高。对称地，对于事前违约风险较高的企业，更大的负向意外可能会提高披露，尽管对均值的推断更为悲观，因为更高的方差使这些企业更有可能避免违约。将我们的分析扩展到多个分析师预测，我们预测不仅共识，而且离散度也会影响企业的披露可能性。共识传递了关于现金流均值和方差的信息，而离散度则提供了关于分析师信号精确度的信息，这反过来又影响预测的信息含量。本文由会计领域的Suraj Srinivasan接受。资助：D. Lee-Lo 衷心感谢凯洛格商学院会计研究中心的财务支持。
publisher: Institute for Operations Research and the Management Sciences (INFORMS)
title: Public Signals, Default Risk, and Voluntary Disclosure
title_zh: 公共信号、违约风险与自愿披露
